name: werknario-webide-agent-workspace
description: werknario — an agent that proposes document changes as reviewable, auditable diffs. Git (GitLab or GitHub) is the document store, a human approves, and every step lands in a tamper-evident audit log. CLI, VS Code Web IDE extension, GDPR-aware multi-model.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @werknario/shared && npm run build -w @werknario/gitlab-client && npm run build -w @werknario/proxy && npm run build -w @werknario/cli && npm run build -w werknario-webide-agent
